Walking Tour – Old Town Highlights

Our two-hour tour begins at the main square at 10 a.m. and ends at the cathedral. [1] Guides will lead you through narrow streets, historic markets, and the city's oldest library. The tour [2] light walking, so comfortable shoes are recommended. Children under six join for free, [3] older children must pay half price. In case of heavy rain, the tour will be [4] to the following day.

choices: The cathedral was damaged in a fire.
Souvenirs are sold at the airport.
Taxi fares are regulated by the city.
No reservation is necessary for groups of fewer than ten people.
questions.explanation: The sentence gives practical information about the tour before the route is described.
A tour 'involves' walking, meaning it includes it.
The sentence contrasts the price for younger and older children.
The passive 'will be postponed' is needed.

text:
Dear Mr. Fraser,

Thank you for contacting Brightwave Appliances about your washing machine. We are sorry that the unit stopped working after only eight months. [1] Since the product is still under warranty, we will repair or replace it at no cost to you. A technician will visit your home between 9 a.m. and noon on Wednesday, [2] you must be present to let him in. Please have the proof of purchase [3] when he arrives. Should the problem not be resolved, we will [4] you with a new machine.

Sincerely,
Customer Care Team

choices: Our factory is located in Ohio.
Washing machines are available in three sizes.
Our offices will be closed next Monday.
We understand how inconvenient this must be for you.
questions.explanation: The sentence shows sympathy before the solution is offered.
The technician's visit has a consequence: someone must be present.
An adjective is needed after the object 'proof of purchase'.
After 'will', the base form is needed; 'provide ... with' is the construction.

text:
Housing Market Cools as Interest Rates Rise

Home sales fell for the third consecutive month in October, [1] to figures released on Monday by the National Realtors Association. Sales of existing homes dropped 4 percent, while the median price rose only 1 percent. [2] Analysts believe that higher borrowing costs have discouraged many first-time buyers. Some economists expect the market to [3] by spring if rates stabilize. Meanwhile, builders [4] fewer new houses than they did a year ago.

questions.explanation: 'According to' introduces a source of information.

choices: The slowdown is most noticeable in suburban areas.
Rental prices have been stable in the city center.
Many people prefer to live near the coast.
questions.explanation: The sentence comments on the decline and precedes the explanation given by analysts.
A market 'recovers' when it improves after a decline.
'Meanwhile' with the plural subject 'builders' requires the present continuous.

text:
Dear all,

We are pleased to announce a series of customer service workshops, which will [1] on the first Wednesday of each month beginning in February. [2] Each workshop lasts two hours and focuses on a different skill, such as handling complaints or [3] with difficult customers. Participation is voluntary, but staff members who attend all six sessions will [4] a certificate of achievement. To sign up, please reply to this e-mail.

Best regards,

questions.explanation: Events 'take place', meaning they happen.

choices: The company cafeteria has a new chef.
Parking spaces are assigned each year.
The sessions are open to employees from all departments.
The annual report will be printed in April.
questions.explanation: The sentence introduces who can join, before the details of each workshop.
A gerund parallel to 'handling' is needed.
One 'earns' a certificate, meaning one gets it through effort.

text:
MEMO
To: All employees

Subject: New expense system

[1] The new platform allows employees to photograph receipts with their phones and [2] them directly to the finance team. Reports that used to take hours can now be completed in minutes. Training videos will be [3] on the intranet starting next week. [4] you have any difficulty, the help desk will be happy to assist you.

choices: The finance team works on the fifth floor.
Business travel has increased this year.
All past reports will be transferred automatically.

questions.explanation: The sentence concerns the switch to the new system, before its features are described.
A base form parallel to 'photograph' is needed.
The passive 'will be posted' is needed.
'Should you have' is a formal inversion meaning 'If you have'.

text:
Grand Opening – The Daily Grind Café

We are open every day from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., [4] free Wi-Fi throughout.

questions.explanation: The past participle 'made' modifies 'lunches'.

choices: The café is located near the bank.
Coffee prices have risen this year.
Our staff will attend a training course.
Live music will be performed from 10 a.m. to noon.
questions.explanation: The sentence adds an opening-day attraction, before the offer for the first customers.
A gerund parallel to 'meetings' and 'studying' is needed.
'With free Wi-Fi' lists an extra feature.

text:
Dear Dr. Ibrahim,

Thank you for agreeing to be a speaker at the Global Health Forum in Vienna on September 9. [1] We would like to confirm that your session, titled Digital Tools in Patient Care, is scheduled for 2 p.m. in Hall B. Your presentation should last thirty minutes, [2] by fifteen minutes of questions. We will [3] your travel and accommodation, as agreed. Could you please send us your slides by August 25 so that we can [4] them in the conference materials?

Warm regards,
Elena Petrova, Forum Organizer

choices: Vienna is a popular tourist destination.
The forum was canceled last year.
We are honored to welcome you to this year's event.

questions.explanation: The sentence expresses thanks, followed by the confirmation of the session.
'Followed by' describes the order of the presentation and the questions.
'Cover' means to pay for expenses.
Slides are 'included' in the conference materials.

text:
Visiting Hours – St. Anne's Hospital

To help patients rest and recover, visiting hours are from 2 p.m. to 8 p.m. daily. [1] No more than two visitors are [2] in a patient room at the same time. Children under twelve must be accompanied by an adult. Flowers are not permitted in intensive care, [3] some patients are sensitive to strong smells. All visitors are asked to wash their hands both [4] and after their visit.

choices: The hospital cafeteria is open until 7 p.m.
These hours apply to all wards except the maternity unit.
Parking fees will increase in January.
Doctors are available for consultations by appointment.
questions.explanation: The sentence qualifies the visiting hours and precedes the limit on visitors.
The passive 'are allowed' is needed.
The ban on flowers is explained by patients' sensitivity.
'Both before and after' is the fixed correlative.
